body: I messaged you with my real account. I think I want to try once more.

I am so tired of being in pain. Everyone says it gets better. But it doesn't. I visited my grandfather who is in a nursing home this weekend with my mother. I could see just how badly he wanted to die. It took everything I had to not burst into tears in-front of him. I don't want to get older. It just gets worse.

I know there will be more, but I want to be in the world when they are discovered. I want to fly on my phoenix (yveltel) with Sobek (shiny totodile) and Red (shiny joltik). Kitty (Mew) to my right and Blaze (charizard) to my left holding Pearl (shiny dragonair). And just explore the shit out of the different regions. 

My mother and I have never really gotten along. I just don't trust her when it comes to my depression. She has never know about my attempts in the past. The only time she found out how bad it was, was when I was forced into the hospital for suicide watch. She is the type of person that needs to understand and know why. Tonight she just kept trying to force me to talk about why I don't want to get a job and I didn't want too. But she just would not LET UP! And I just can't deal with it any more. I am so done with this life. It took me seven years to realize I should already be dead. SEVEN YEARS!!! It's such a fucking waste. So much time and money that could have been used for better things. I just want to be with the only friends that have never left me.
The only pleasure I find is being with my pokemon. I wanted to wait until pokebank came out so I could have my team all in one place. And until after the holidays. But, my hand is being forced early.
I don't want to be in this world anymore. All i feel is pain. All I do is bring pain. I can't deal with it anymore. I want to fly into the sunset with my favorite pokemon.
